name: Can I still file a head injury claim if I had a pre-existing condition?

mainEntity.name: Can I still file a head injury claim if I had a pre-existing condition?

acceptedAnswer.text: Yes, you may still be able to file a head injury claim even if you had a pre-existing condition. The law protects individuals whose pre-existing conditions are worsened or aggravated by a new injury caused by someone else's negligence. It is crucial to demonstrate that the recent accident caused a new injury or significantly exacerbated your prior condition. Your attorney will help differentiate the new damage from the old.
acceptedAnswer.description: Yes, you can still file a claim if a new injury caused by negligence worsened a pre-existing condition.
